notes.title: Respark Demo is now available in English!
notes.content:
Exciting News for Respark Fans!

We are thrilled to announce that Respark Demo is now fully available in English! Thank you for your incredible support since the launch of our demo a month ago. Your feedback has been invaluable.

Starting today, you can enjoy the full Respark experience in both English and Japanese. Dive into an explosive adventure with a demo packed with as much content and excitement as a full version.

Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

nokoyama / Enigmatic Network
